instruction: Select a suitable tool from ANSYS, Abaqus, and AutoCAD to complete the task. For this task, launch Abaqus CAE or AutoCAD 2024 from their desktop shortcuts; ANSYS MAPDL is available at `C:\Program Files\ANSYS Inc\v261\ansys\bin\winx64\ANSYS261.exe`. Use the selected tool to perform a linear buckling analysis of a thin plate (Variant A). Use the N-mm-MPa unit system. Model Definition: Create a 3D Deformable Shell planar part. Sketch a square plate from (0, 0) to (96, 96) in the X-Y plane. Material and Section: Define a material named Steel with Young's modulus E = 210000 MPa and Poisson's ratio nu = 0.3. Create a Homogeneous Shell Section with a thickness of 1.2 mm and 5 through-thickness integration points, and assign it to the entire plate. Assembly: Create one dependent instance of the plate. Analysis Step: Create a Linear Perturbation Buckle step named Step-Buckle-A. Request 3 eigenvalues. Discretization: Mesh the plate with a global seed size of 6 mm. Assign appropriate shell element formulation shell elements and generate the mesh. Loads and Boundary Conditions: Apply the compressive edge load of 1.2 N/mm on the two vertical edges as equivalent nodal forces after meshing. On the X = 0 edge, apply nodal forces in the positive X direction. On the X = 96 edge, apply nodal forces in the negative X direction. With an edge length of 96 mm and mesh spacing of 6 mm, apply 7.2 N to each interior edge node and 3.6 N to each corner edge node on each loaded vertical edge. Apply U3 = 0 on all four plate edges (X = 0, X = 96, Y = 0, and Y = 96) to represent simply supported transverse conditions. At the center mesh node approximately located at (48, 48, 0), constrain U1 = U2 = 0 to suppress in-plane translational rigid-body motion. At the bottom-edge midpoint mesh node approximately located at (48, 0, 0), constrain U1 = 0 only to suppress the remaining in-plane rotational rigid-body mode. Job Execution: Create a job named Job-Buckle-A, submit it for analysis, and wait for the analysis to complete successfully. Post-Processing: Review the first buckling mode and record the first eigenvalue. Deliverables: save the native model artifact and the native solver result artifact into `C:\Users\user\Desktop\result`. Save only the files from the selected tool. Software launch locations: Abaqus/CAE: `C:\Users\user\Desktop\Abaqus CAE.lnk`; ANSYS: multiple ANSYS launch shortcuts are available under `C:\Users\Public\Desktop`; choose the most suitable ANSYS shortcut for the task; AutoCAD 2024: `C:\Users\Public\Desktop\AutoCAD 2024.lnk`.
